name: Reverse Array
code:
# Reverse Array (RISC-V assembly)
# Reverses a[0] .. a[n-1] in place with two pointers
#
# a0 = base address of the array
# a1 = number of elements n
# t0 = i (left pointer), t1 = j (right pointer)

    li a0, 0x0          # base address of the array
    li a1, 0xA          # n = 10 elements
    li t0, 0x0          # i = 0
    addi t1, a1, -1     # j = n - 1

loop:
    bge t0, t1, done          # i >= j -> finished
    slli t2, t0, 0x2          # t2 = i * 4
    add t2, a0, t2            # t2 = &a[i]
    slli t3, t1, 0x2          # t3 = j * 4
    add t3, a0, t3            # t3 = &a[j]
    lw  t4, 0x0(t2)           # t4 = a[i]
    lw  t5, 0x0(t3)           # t5 = a[j]
    sw  t5, 0x0(t2)           # a[i] = a[j]
    sw  t4, 0x0(t3)           # a[j] = a[i]
    addi t0, t0, 0x1          # i++
    addi t1, t1, -1           # j--
    j loop

done:
